prs.title: fix(everything-server): classify by the wire's markers, not by the presence of _meta
prs.author: po-et
prs.reason: [llm pick] cluster primary for issue #506: I could not reach GitHub from this sandbox (gh, git fetch, and WebFetch were all blocked with no network access available), so I can't verify actual CI results, test coverage, or precise diff stats beyond what's given — both are stated as CI: unknown and files: 2, a tie on the two hardest tiebreakers. Deciding on approach specifics from the titles: #510 fixes the root cause by changing the discriminator used to classify messages (wire protocol markers) in the everything-server, which is the component where issue #506's misclassification actually occurs. #507 instead patches the initialize handler to tolerate metadata only on the stateful path, which addresses one call site rather than the underlying classification logic — a narrower patch that may leave other paths exposed to the same #506 bug. Recommend re-verifying CI/tests once network access is available before merging.
